i < NUM_SAMPLES; i++) {\n        radiiSq[i] = rand.nextFloat(inner2, outer2);\n      }\n      const prev = [...radiiSq];\n      for (let i = 0; i < NUM_SAMPLES; i++) {\n        const l = (i - 1 + NUM_SAMPLES) % NUM_SAMPLES;\n        const r = (i + 1) % NUM_SAMPLES;\n        radiiSq[i] = prev[i] * 0.6 + prev[l] * 0.2 + prev[r] * 0.2;\n      }\n      for (let py = y0; py <= y1; py++) {\n        for (let px = x0; px <= x1; px++) {\n          const d2 = dx * dx + dy * dy;\n          if (d2 > outer2) continue;\n          if (d2 > inner2) {\n            // interpolated threshold check\n          }\n        }\n      }\n    } else {\n      this.tilesToDestroyCache = this.mg.bfs(this.dst, (_, n: TileRef) => {\n        const d2 = this.mg?.euclideanDistSquared(this.dst, n) ?? 0;\n        return (\n          d2 <= outer2 &&\n          (d2 <= inner2 || rand.chance(2)) &&\n          !this.mg.isImpassable(n)\n        );\n      });\n    }\n    // ... later in detonate():\n    for (const unit of mg.units()) {\n      if (mg.euclideanDistSquared(dst, unit.tile()) < outer2) {\n        const friendly = this.player.isFriendly(unit.owner(), true);\n        unit.delete(true, friendly ? undefined : this.player);\n      }\n    }\n```\n\n--------------------------------\n\n### euclDistFN — Euclidean distance predicate factory\n\nSource: https://github.com/openfrontio/openfrontio/blob/main/packages/engine-lib/src/game/GameMapImpl.ts\n\nCreates a closure that checks whether a tile is within a given Euclidean distance from a root tile. Used in nation nuke behavior to score tiles within the outer blast radius, and in Util.getSpawnTiles for unit placement.\n\n```typescript\nexport function euclDistFN(\n  root: TileRef,\n  dist: number,\n  center: boolean = false,\n): (gm: GameMap, tile: TileRef) => boolean {\n  const dist2 = dist * dist;\n  if (!center) {\n    return (gm: GameMap, n: TileRef) =>\n      gm.euclideanDistSquared(root, n) <= dist2;\n  } else {\n    return (gm: GameMap, n: TileRef) => {\n      const rootX = gm.x(root) - 0.5;\n      const rootY = gm.y(root) - 0.5;\n      const dx = gm.x(n) - rootX;\n      const dy = gm.y(n) - rootY;\n      return dx * dx + dy * dy <= dist2;\n    };\n  }\n}\n```\n\n--------------------------------\n\n### Nation nuke targeting\n\nSource: https://github.com/openfrontio/openfrontio/blob/main/packages/engine/src/execution/nation/NationNukeBehavior.ts\n\nNationNukeBehavior.ts (packages/engine/src/execution/nation/) is the AI nation's nuke targeting engine: maybeSendNuke() gates on MissileSilo availability, selects a target, enumerates nuke types (Hydrogen first, Atom on Hard/Impossible), and picks the best tile via findBestNukeTile() for each candidate.\n\n```typescript\n  maybeSendNuke() {\n    const silos = this.player.units(UnitType.MissileSilo);\n    const config = this.game.config();\n    if (\n      silos.length === 0 ||\n      config.isUnitDisabled(UnitType.MissileSilo) ||\n      (config.isUnitDisabled(UnitType.AtomBomb) &&\n        config.isUnitDisabled(UnitType.HydrogenBomb))\n    ) {\n      return;\n    }\n\n    const choice = this.chooseNukeTarget();\n    if (choice === null) {\n      return;\n    }\n    const { target: nukeTarget, strike } = choice;\n\n    if (\n      nukeTarget.type() === PlayerType.Bot || // Don't nuke tribes (as opposed to nations and humans)\n      this.player.isOnSameTeam(nukeTarget) ||\n      this.attackBehavior.shouldAttack(nukeTarget) === false\n    ) {\n      return;\n    }\n\n    // While saving up for a MIRV, Hard & Impossible only nuke back at players hitting them, with atom bombs\n    const saving = this.isS
